notes: Build.commonjsOptions is a Vite 8 no-op; native Rolldown handling and explicit package-name prebundling replace it.
Absolute-file prebundling did not rewrite relative CJS imports. Desktop uses canonical existing private package names, shared TS paths, Vite/test alias resolver and explicit optimizeDeps include.

First dev probe failed on shared CommonJS named exports, then the metadata read hit plugin package exports restrictions; both corrected. Final HMR check uses both actual shared runtimes and preserves counter=1.
Four desktop source files changed only shared import identifiers; Node/mobile CommonJS entries and generated runtime bytes remain unchanged. No workspace or directory migration.
Native production probe imports six delayed modules from file URLs. Dev probe is a small actual React fixture under real project config, not a complete IPC-backed development application.
Old workspace dist copy/baseline marker were missing; old assets recovered only from frozen, SHA-verified previous ASAR and both before package/lock snapshots match that evidence.
Asset byte/gzip observations are not controlled build speed, startup, frame-rate or memory measurements; gzip uses the same local Node/zlib defaults on each version.

Actual package disables publishing, signing and branding edits, preserves original release directory and uses a new portable profile. One short silent H264 smoke does not establish all codecs, hardware decode, sustained budgets or physical mobile acceptance.
Mobile lock unchanged and type/correctness checks passed; no fresh mobile audit, Hermes export or native APK/IPA in this batch.
CI configuration inspected but remote jobs not dispatched; remaining tooling/mobile dependencies, migration, signatures, update manifests, TLS and native acceptance still open.
